notes.title: Demo Update and Online World merging
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is a huge update of the GUILT free Demo. The demo is now running on the latest update.

In addition, the demo now shares the same Online World server as the full retail game. This means demo characters will leave corpses for the full game characters and vice versa, as well as other online interactions.

If a demo player wishes to continue their character, they can now buy the full game and resume from where they left off.

Consider sharing the free demo with friends, it's a juicy one.

Please let us know your thoughts, and consider [url=https://discord.com/invite/pNH9a47/]joining us on Discord[/url] to help vote on new features and offer feedback.

notes.title: Infinite Worlds Ascension Update 0.6.20
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we're excited to unleash the infinite world ascension system!

Each defeat of the second boss, challenge yourself to a new loop of the world with your current character. All online players will share the same ascended worlds.

At the beginning of every ascension, your character and all items will be permanently saved for that loop. We think this will add a fun dynamic of optimizing your runs so that you can always have a good start on your next loop.

In addition, we have overhauled the way that chests and keys work. Each dungeon will now be labelled for a certain type of gear, so hunt for a key and then seek out dungeons that have the loot you're lacking.

Please let us know your thoughts, and consider joining us on [url=http://discord.outerbrainstudios.com/]Discord[/url] to help vote on new features and offer feedback.

Best,
Outer Brain Team

This update to the demo adds a story segment with Koschei and addresses issues and feedback that we received from players.

Please let us know what you think, and consider joining us on [url=https://discord.gg/JyzkePMWH4]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Guilt Demo Update: Procedural dungeon overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

In preparation for more interaction with the new open-world hex map, we've also gone ahead and completely redone the way dungeons are generated.

Gone is the controversial/buggy fog of war system, now you can look around and fully take in the foggy landscapes. Player corpses will now be saved at the exact position where they died, and dungeons will have the same persistent random layout generated at the creation of the world/server.

Please let us know what you think, and consider joining us on Discord

Best,
Dmitry

notes.title: Guilt Demo Update: Open-world hex map
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're finally ready to reveal the early state of our new hex map overworld. We've replaced the old linear metamap with this new open world hex map, we think it will add a lot to the sense of adventure and exploration.

As always, all players will affect the map with their corpses and guilt. We hope to expand the ways in which you can cooperate and plan with other players soon.

Please let us know what you think, and consider joining us on [url=https://discord.gg/JyzkePMWH4]Discord [/url]

Best,
Dmitry
